source_image.inspection: Original image viewed; pudding barcode and gelatin flavour inspected using an in-memory enlarged crop of the same pixels. No generated detail or GT was used.

policy.geometry_axis_policy: Object-local semantic dimensions only. No camera/world axes or pose inferred from a product specification.
policy.uncertainty_policy: Unreported measurement tolerances remain null. No invented percentages or millimetre error bars. Published disagreements are retained separately.
policy.texture_policy: Visible source artwork may guide appearance; current manufacturer artwork is not an exact historic back-face reconstruction. Do not use Desk1 GT textures/meshes.

image_identity.back_face: Not observed; exact reverse artwork and seam placement unresolved.

dimension_candidates.dimension_scope: single physical reference carton, not shipping packaging
dimension_candidates.axis_mapping_basis: Paper gives an unlabeled dimension tuple; semantic mapping inferred from the front-panel aspect and thin carton depth in the real source photo. Not a paper-defined XYZ frame.
dimension_candidates.exact_or_estimated: Published nominal reference dimensions; estimated prior for Desk1
dimension_candidates.uncertainty: Paper gives no metrology tolerance. Packaging version and carton wear can differ; reference mass is not used as proof of the source net contents.

structural_details.detail: Planar printed paperboard faces, folded end-panel edge and slight edge wear are directly visible; keep print upside down relative to the upright source object.
Complete the unseen face as a planar carton wall. No measured cardboard thickness, flap depth or exact reverse label was found; leave numerical values unspecified.

Cap length, clip envelope, barrel cross-section, taper, opposite-side print and material optical constants are not numerically specified by the checked sources.

access_limitations: YCB benchmark homepage and Berkeley YCB landing page returned access errors through the browser fetch; original author papers were used instead.
No exact historic US Strawberry Banana manufacturer packaging specification was established; current Canadian and zero-sugar pages are retained with explicit mismatch.
A guessed manufacturer 5 oz chocolate URL was inaccessible; no unsupported official 5 oz SKU or dimensions were promoted.
Retailer search snippets were not used as accepted dimension evidence. No shipping or multipack dimension was assigned to an individual object.
pipeline_recommendation: Bind this source image hash and explicit source IDs to each adopted prior. Freeze one dimension candidate per arm before fitting; derive pose only from allowed real images/calibration. Keep a source-only baseline and an external-prior-assisted route distinct. Backside completion and physical material values remain assumed; these sources establish neither reconstruction acceptance nor SOTA.
